notes: Coverage: p. 59 last row from 'ārit' (hall 4 line 1); p. 60 all 9 hieroglyphic rows (the brief speaks of rows 1-10, but I count 9 printed rows on p. 60: ut'ā-nà in braces is in row 5, 'The Fifth Ārit.' in row 7); p. 61 rows 1-4 (plate XI) and rows 5-8 after 'PLATE XII.' (plate XII); p. 62 all 9 rows; p. 63 rows 1-4 to 'χer - k', stopping before Spell 146. The labels 'The Fourth/Fifth/Sixth/Seventh Ārit.' are not recorded. Line numerals restart in each hall. Proper names split across numerals keep the line of their first sign: hall 4 'ḥrà-āśt-χeru' (numeral 3 inside), hall 5 'Ṭeb-ḥrà-keḥa-χeft' (numeral 6 inside; split across pp. 60-61 into two entries, both line 5), hall 6 'Àtek-tau-kehaq-χeru' (3 inside), hall 6 'Aṭes-ḥrà' (split pp. 61-62, line 6), hall 7 'Seχem-Maṭenu-sen' (3 inside). Overlines: none on p. 59 hall-4 heading; p. 60 ren+en (lines 3,5 hall 4; line 3,4 hall 5), ārit+ṭuat; p. 61 t'eṭ àn, Āpep, ārit+saset, ren+en (lines 3, 5 hall 6); p. 62 t'eṭ àn (twice), ārit+seχef, ren (line 3) and en at start of next row, ren (line 5, not the following en). The figure written for ren/nuk/nà (seated man with arm raised to face) is coded A1 throughout per house ruling; seated figures with lappet wig after divine/demon names coded A40. A flat bar with an upright tab at the right and no curl (in ut'ā, maāt, ḥenà, uā, sāḥ, Āā) is coded D36 (arm, hand not drawn); the similar sign with upcurled left end (after χesef, in sati, net', seśeṭ, user, Seχem) is coded U15 per ruling. The loop-with-netted-bulb in semà, mān, mà is coded W19 (mi). Bracketed restorations: p. 60 meter-[nef], p. 60 fe[n]t, p. 62 [maat en], p. 62 seχef's seventh stroke, p. 62 maa-[k]. No brackets found in p. 61 row 2. Faint thin vertical dashed line through the curled sign of 'àri āa - s' on p. 60 row 1 looks like a print artefact.
